title: Hand-Written Scenes Become Scripts: 3 Types Became 8 | vitalii.no
description:
Every new teaching scenario for my kids' TV wall used to mean me hand-coding a new React component — one file per exercise type, with no way to check whether the animation actually matched the lesson before it reached the kids.

Now a lesson is authored as a script instead of code: a short description with five timed beats, put together automatically by an AI session running in the background. That script is checked twice — once before the wall accepts it, once again on the screen itself — before a child ever sees it.

Hand-coded exercise types went from three to eight in a single week, and the newest five needed zero new code written by hand.
